name: lucuma-pm
description: Lucuma Proyectos: gestión de proyectos tipo Basecamp para agencias, con portal de clientes

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lucuma-pm/shared && (npm run dev -w @lucuma-pm/api & npm run dev -w @lucuma-pm/web)
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lucuma-pm/shared && npm run build -w @lucuma-pm/api && npm run build -w @lucuma-pm/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/api && tsc -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lucuma-pm/shared && npm run test -w @lucuma-pm/api
